brief:
Israeli forces arrested an elderly Palestinian man following an assault by a settler in an area south of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The circumstances surrounding the attack and the sequence of events that led to the arrest were not immediately detailed in initial accounts of the incident.

The region south of Hebron has long been a flashpoint for confrontations between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers. Tensions in the area frequently escalate into physical altercations and other incidents. The arrest of the elderly man came after the settler's attack, rather than any immediate action by authorities against the individual who allegedly carried out the assault.
title: Israeli forces arrest elderly Palestinian after settler attacks him south of Hebron
